items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: in those days there were a lot of great musicians, J.C. Moses, the great drummer.

ctx.x: I said Andrew, It's just flys, It's a river. It flows, I can’t keep it. Consciousness is not consecutive, consciousness just is, it's not consecutive. See that's why I don't talk like that. Anyway, I said, listen man Cannon told me I have to have double scale if I record cause he said that's what fair for me now. I haven't played with him, and Andrew said "no problem man." So Blue Note had a thing in those days where they would have you rehearse the music in front of them, so they had a rehearsal studio, and they…
